Agent: I understand your disappointment with "Spirits Out of Time." It seems like the book didn't live up to your expectations.
User: Can you recommend something else for me?

Agent: Sure, I think you might enjoy "I Never Believed In Ghosts Until . . ." It's a collection of true ghost stories from various sources. It offers a wide variety of stories from different locations and time periods. The narrators are both young and old, and the book has received positive reviews.
User: That sounds interesting. Can you tell me more about "I Never Believed In Ghosts Until . . ."?

Agent: "I Never Believed In Ghosts Until . . ." features over 100 true ghost stories, making it a comprehensive collection. The stories come from different parts of the country, and some even take place in other countries. The book includes both long-standing family legends and recent accounts. It offers a diverse range of ghosts, some of which are friendly. Overall, it's a highly enjoyable read for ghost story enthusiasts.
User: That sounds great! I'll definitely give it a try. Thanks for the recommendation.
Agent: You're welcome! I hope you enjoy "I Never Believed In Ghosts Until . . ." Let me know if you have any other questions or need further recommendations.
